no_reentrancy_guard_present.meaning: addRewards and claimRewards perform transfers and state changes without a nonReentrant guard

pending_accounting_increased_before_tran.meaning: pending-reward accounting has already been increased while the external transferFrom has not completed
pending_accounting_increased_before_tran.checkpoint: during addRewards, after accounting update and before transferFrom completion

reentrant_entrypoint_invoked.meaning: claimRewards or another entrypoint is invoked during the addRewards reentrancy window

preconditions.text: addRewards and claimRewards are external functions that perform transfers and state changes without a nonReentrant guard
preconditions.derivation: Program conjunction of selected report preconditions.

safety.text: addRewards must not expose a reentrancy window in which claimRewards or other entrypoints can be invoked while pending-reward accounting has already been increased but the external transferFrom has not completed
safety.derivation: Program synthesis from the selected intent and logical pattern.

effects.derivation: Program-generated direct negation witness for the selected safety pattern.

effect_coverage.reason: Program-generated exact coverage for selected direct impact.

assumptions: The malicious or reentrant token is used as the reward asset during addRewards.

limitations: Griefing is encoded as a grounded Boolean because the report provides no more specific observable outcome.
The reentrancy window is represented at the ordering level between accounting increase and transferFrom completion; concrete amounts and balances are not specified by the report.
